<!--- js dependencies -->
<script src="https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js"></script>
<script src="js/scatterplot.js"></script>
<script src="js/h_barchart.js"></script>

```{r}
#| include: false
source(knitr::purl('explore.qmd'))

ojs_define(
  country_level_2024 = country_level_2024 %>% 
    select(
      consulate_country,
      consulate_country_code,
      consulate_country_continent,
      tot_request,
      gdp_per_capita,
      ratio_rejected,
      fitted = .fitted
    ) %>% 
    drop_na() %>% 
    {
    transpose(.l = .)
  }
)
```

```{ojs}
height = 500
cb_palette = {
  let cb_palette = {
  Africa: "#228833",
  Americas: "#CCBB44",
  Asia: "#4477AA",
  Europe: "#EE6677",
  Oceania: "#AA3377",
  }
  return cb_palette
}
```

## Schengen Visa Rejection Rate


```{ojs} 

Scatterplot(country_level_2024,
  {
    x: d => d.gdp_per_capita,
    y: d => d.ratio_rejected,
    area: d => d.tot_request,
    fill: d => d.consulate_country_continent,
    id: d => d.consulate_country_code,
    label: d => d.consulate_country,
    fitted: d => d.fitted,
    fillPalette: cb_palette,
    width: width,
    height: height,
    voronoiShow: false,
    year: 2024,
  }
)
```

```{ojs} 
sortedData = country_level_2024.slice().sort((a, b) => b.ratio_rejected - a.ratio_rejected);

h_barchart(sortedData.slice(0,30), {
  label: d => d.consulate_country,
  value: d => +(d.ratio_rejected * 100).toFixed(2),
  continent: d => d.consulate_country_continent,
  total: d => d.tot_request,
});



```
